$comment: Entry schema for contributes.dashboardWidgets (process plugins only, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_dashboard_widgets.go and dashboard_widget_data.go. A view widget embeds one of the plugin's contributes.views in the sandboxed plugin UI iframe (surface "widget", {{limits.liveFramesMax}} live frames at most, no file drop) and must not declare action or refreshSeconds. A data widget names one of the plugin's contributes.actions with risk read; the host calls it with the fixed payload {"widget": id} (timeout {{limits.timeoutMs}} ms, {{limits.concurrentPerPlugin}} concurrent calls per plugin) only while the card is visible, and accepts a result {items: [{label, value, severity?, hint?}] (at most {{limits.itemsMax}}), footnote?, updatedAt?} of at most {{limits.resultMaxBytes}} bytes, rendered as plain text. refreshSeconds is 0 (manual only) or {{limits.refreshMinSeconds}}-{{limits.refreshMaxSeconds}} (default {{limits.refreshDefaultSeconds}}). command is one of the plugin's own contributes.commands, run from the card's Open button through the normal command path. The host shows at most {{limits.hostCardsMax}} cards; users hide and reorder cards per workspace.
description: Dashboard widgets: small cards on the dashboard that show a plugin view or read-only label/value data.

view.description: view widgets: one of this plugin's contributes.views ids.

action.description: data widgets: one of this plugin's contributes.actions ids with risk read.

size.description: Card height: small (180 px) or medium (280 px); defaults to small.

refreshSeconds.description: data widgets: 0 for manual refresh only, otherwise {{limits.refreshMinSeconds}}-{{limits.refreshMaxSeconds}}; refresh happens only while the card is visible.

command.description: One of this plugin's contributes.commands ids, offered as the card's Open button.
